description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the QueryFaceVideoTemplate operation for querying video face fusion templates
description_zh: 本文介绍视频人脸融合模版查询QueryFaceVideoTemplate的语法及示例
name: QueryFaceVideoTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template to query. If TemplateId is not specified, the template list of the user is returned. If TemplateId is specified, only the corresponding result is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的模板ID。如果未传TemplateId，返回该用户的模板列表；如果传入TemplateId，仅返回对应的结果
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 5000
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数设置，默认第1页。取值范围为1~5000
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 当前页条数设置，默认100条。取值范围为1~500
parameters.name: page_size

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the template was created

FaceInfos.description_en:
The face ID and position information for each face when the input video contains multiple faces.

FaceInfos is returned only when the multi-person video face swap scenario is selected during template creation (the VideoScene parameter must be set to `multi`)
FaceInfos.description_zh:
用户输入视频为多个人脸时，返回各人脸ID和位置信息。

只有在添加模板时选择了多人视频换脸场景（即VideoScene参数必须传入`multi`值）时，才会返回FaceInfos信息

items.description_en:
The face ID and position information for each face when the input video contains multiple faces.

FaceInfos is returned only when the multi-person video face swap scenario is selected during template creation (the VideoScene parameter must be set to `multi`)
items.description_zh:
用户输入视频为多个人脸时，返回各人脸ID和位置信息。

只有在添加模板时选择了多人视频换脸场景（即VideoScene参数必须传入`multi`值）时，才会返回FaceInfos信息

TemplateFaceID.description_en: The sub-template ID corresponding to the face

TemplateFaceURL.description_en: The face image corresponding to the sub-template ID of the face
TemplateFaceURL.description_zh: 人脸对应的子模板ID对应的人脸图

TemplateURL.description_en:
The URL of the video face template that was specified when the template was added.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
TemplateURL.description_zh:
新增模板时设置的视频人脸模板地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the template was updated

Total.description_en: The total number of available templates under the current account
Total.description_zh: 当前账号下的可用模板总数量
